contexts.text: Bringing him forth abroad () = the sight of the interior man, which from external things sees internal things. Explained.
When they had brought them forth abroad () = the state when they are being withheld from falsity and evil. AC 2413.
Bring her forth and let her be burnt () = that it is to be extirpated... To bring forth is predicated of truth, and to burn of good, which are to be extirpated.
As by going forth from the womb is signified the rebirth, and thence the Church, the Lord is called... the bringer forth from the womb, etc. Illustrated.
Bring me out of this house () = deliverance from evils. To bring out = deliverance.
Because I drew him out of the waters () = deliverance from falsities. To draw out = deliverance.

Bring forth my people the Sons of Israel out of Egypt () = the deliverance of those who are of the spiritual Church from the falsities which infest them. To bring forth = deliverance. AC 6868. AC 7235. AC 7238. AC 7277. AC 7282. AC 7932. AC 7990. AC 8018. AC 8050. AC 8411. AC 8528. AC 8646. AC 8866. AC 9197. AC 10156, Explained.
I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians () = that the Lord will release them from the infestations of those who are in falsities. To bring out = to release.

In this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt () = a state then of charity and faith through which there is separation from those who are evils and falsities... To bring out = to be separated.
Thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house () = that this good shall not be commingled with any other good. Explained.
These three feasts were instituted on account of the bringing forth of the human race... out of Hell, and their introduction into Heaven.
He cannot bring himself out of his falsities...
Deliverance (from evils and falsities) is meant by Thou broughtest us out into breadth ().
To bring out Israel from among them () = to open the spiritual man, and so to regenerate him. Explained.
Reformation through the Divine truth which is from Him is signified by He bringeth the wind out of His treasuries ().
